speaker: skeptic
message: Commitment: conceded "Speed cannot replace strict government security checks and clear developer liabi"

data.claim_text: Speed cannot replace strict government security checks and clear developer liability under international humanitarian law. High-risk fields like civil aviation and nuclear plants demand deep tests before deployment. The Federal Aviation Administration requires millions of hours of flight tests before clearing autopilot tools for public use. Defense buyers must use that same standard for targeting systems before they go into the field. If a contractor cannot prove its code stops safely on command, the Department of Defense must cut its funding.

speaker: skeptic
message: Commitment: conceded "Clear developer liability stops private firms from making money on lethal softwa"

data.claim_text: Clear developer liability stops private firms from making money on lethal software bugs while avoiding lawsuits or criminal charges. Current defense contracts protect tech vendors from civilian deaths caused by bad algorithms in war zones. Congress must pass reform laws that remove legal shields from drone code makers when their work breaks the laws of war. The Department of Justice must keep the power to charge coders and company bosses whose unvetted code causes unlawful civilian deaths. Keeping the off-switch in human hands with real legal risk is the only way to keep war under control.
